name: Spherical Harmonic Volume Rendering
aliases: Advanced Light Material Interaction for DVR
Spherical Harmonic (SH) Volume Rendering with Advanced Material Interaction
definition: A heuristic approach for simulating advanced light material interactions in interactive direct volume rendering (DVR) by incorporating complex material functions (reflectance and scattering) and colored area light sources using a unified Spherical Harmonic (SH) basis representation.
